findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: live_url_metadata, dev_pdf_to_text, dev_url_reader, dev_feed_parser, dev_email_validator, dev_table_extract, nft_collection_activity · Private data: databases_countries, dev_jwt_decoder, dev_http_status_codes, dev_mime_types, live_weather, crypto_price, live_dns_lookup, live_url_metadata, dev_token_estimator, dev_llm_cost_calculator, dev_text_chunker, dev_url_parser, crypto_random_generator, crypto_wallet_snapshot, dev_ics_parser, nft_wallet_nfts · Public sink: live_dns_lookup, dev_text_extract, dev_email_validator · Destructive: calculators_vat_calculator, dev_uuid.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: live_url_metadata, dev_pdf_to_text, dev_url_reader, dev_feed_parser, dev_email_validator, dev_table_extract, nft_collection_activity · Private data: databases_countries, dev_jwt_decoder, dev_http_status_codes, dev_mime_types, live_weather, crypto_price, live_dns_lookup, live_url_metadata, dev_token_estimator, dev_llm_cost_calculator, dev_text_chunker, dev_url_parser, crypto_random_generator, crypto_wallet_snapshot, dev_ics_parser, nft_wallet_nfts · Public sink: live_dns_lookup, dev_text_extract, dev_email_validator · Destructive: calculators_vat_calculator, dev_uuid

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
